versions.changelog:
Summary: Major skill refocus from auto video maker to tier list board creation, with new import documentation and template assets.

- Renamed and refocused the skill from "tierlist-video-maker" (video generation) to "tierlist-maker" (interactive board building & import).
- Removed all video generation and script-related files; skill no longer handles narrated video creation or AI vision for image cards.
- Added onboarding templates, sample tierlist markdowns, and expanded technical references for data import and config.
- The skill now guides users step-by-step to create TierVibe tier lists, building the import URL and launching it in the user's browser.
- Updated description and documentation to match the new creation-focused workflow.

TierList Video Maker 1.0.10 introduces video generation from TierVibe posts:

- New: Generate narrated videos from published TierVibe tier lists via scripts and AI vision.
- Fetches tier list data, images, and commentary from public TierVibe post URLs.
- Automates high-resolution board image capture using Playwright.
- Uses AI to identify cards, generate narration scripts, create TTS audio, and compose a scrolling-video with enlarged cards.
- Vision-free path for text boards or image boards with detailed commentary—vision needed only when cards lack text.
- Only works with published posts, not drafts or editor links.
- Adds detailed script references and workflow documentation.

- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to core logic or user experience; this version only involves minor cleanup.

- The README/skill-card file has been removed.
- Skill now outputs a `launcher.html` file to open the tier list, instead of using OS/browser commands.
- Clarifies image handling: when local files are used and file reading is available, images are embedded as data URLs; otherwise, text placeholders and a manifest are provided.
- New guidance: suggest users name local image files after their items for easier mapping (no vision needed).
- Updates rules and instructions throughout to focus on handing off via `launcher.html`, eliminating use of direct open commands.
- Documentation and workflow clarified for both image and text tier lists.

Version 1.0.3 (was 0.1.2)

- Major update: new versioning, refined rules, and expanded documentation for the interview flow.
- Added strict instructions to never manually transcribe or copy tier list import URLs/base64 payloads—must use tools for reliability.
- Clarified "one question at a time" rule: only ask for info the user hasn't already provided.
- Enforced mandatory `fontSize` for tiers, with explicit sizing guidelines based on title length.
- Improved balancing guidance for tier and candidate pools, with clear user directions.
- Added skill metadata and updated preset/config references; removed obsolete documentation files.

TierList Maker 0.1.1

- First skill release.
- Step-by-step interview guides users to build a tier list for TierVibe.
- Supports both image-based and text-based tier lists, chosen as the first step.
- Handles image workflows: supports only real public URLs or guides users with local files using a manifest and placeholders.
- Generates tier lists with user-defined tiers, items, and markdown commentary for each card.
- Auto-opens the completed tier list in the user's default system browser for final editing and publishing; no file download/drag needed.
- Requires login only at the end; no server calls or early sign-in prompts.

TierList Maker (TierVibe) v0.1.0

- Initial release: build TierVibe tier lists step-by-step through an interactive interview, no file drag needed.
- Auto-opens the created tier list in your browser at tiervibe.com in the final step.
- Fully supports custom tier titles, color styles, and markdown card commentary, with live user choices throughout.
- Commentary detail levels and visual style are user-controlled, not fixed.
- Never requires a login until the final publish step; always asks one question at a time.
